mapper.select: SELECT snapshot::text FROM nw_host_run_settings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_host_run_settings(tenant_id,run_id,snapshot) VALUES(#{tenant},#{run},CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot::text FROM nw_host_operation_settings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND operation_key=#{operation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_host_operation_settings(tenant_id,run_id,operation_key,snapshot) VALUES(#{tenant},#{run},#{operation},CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,run_id,operation_key) DO NOTHING
